description: Change the workspace filters: excludedTerms (a `*` at an end is a wildcard), excludedAuthors (links, handles, names), excludedRepos (owner/name or a github.com link), subreddits.only (an allowlist; when set, excluded is ignored) and subreddits.excluded. Each list optional; an omitted list is untouched, an empty one clears it. Takes effect on new mentions within a minute.

inputSchema.description: Omitted fields are untouched; an empty list clears one.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

subreddits.description: Reddit only; an omitted list is untouched.

excluded.description: Replaces the deny list; [] clears it.

name: update_filters
title: Update filters
